answer: A payout is split so that 42% arrives at settlement and the rest over 19 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. The mesa schedule is applied in jade and zenith shows each instalment. Anyone as a result cannot take the money and run, since most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 1221 identities would post 4138 proofs and burn roughly 50 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
